name: Product documents filed in their own asset categories

dependsOn.why: The documents are attached to the products that recipe creates.

mcpOnly.reason: On MCP 0.6.3 (the oldest proven release) no MCP tool and no recipe Management API command creates a product asset category, so a new category is made in the admin screen; an existing one is found over MCP and the files and documents are written over MCP. From MCP 0.6.6 save_product_asset_categories creates it and every step runs MCP-only (see provenOn).

hosted.reason: As MCP-only: on 0.6.3 the category create has no binding; from 0.6.6 nothing needs SQL or the Management API.

steps.title: Find each product that carries documents (the pim.identifiers recipe creates them)
steps.trap: A lookup: a product the catalogue has not created is WOULD-CREATE here, and its documents wait for it.

steps.title: Ensure one FileSelector asset category per document kind, with its file-type filter
steps.trap: save_product_asset_categories exists from MCP 0.6.6; an older server offers no MCP write for an asset category, so the step is BLOCKED there and the category is made in the admin screen.

steps.title: Upload each document file from the input folder into /Files/Images
steps.trap: upload_file writes only under /Files/Images, /Files/Videos, /Files/Digital assets and /Files/Files/Integration, so a document file shares /Files/Images with the product images and its name must be unique there.

steps.title: Attach each document to its product in its asset category
steps.trap: add_product_image registers any file the category's extensions allow, not only images; get_product_images lists the document among the images but carries no category, so the category is proven on the delivery API (probe documents-delivered).

probes.title: The delivery API lists each document under its asset category on the product

provenOn.evidence: On the add-in rolled back to 0.6.3-BETA, a fictional document filed under an existing category: d1-verify (file and document WOULD-CREATE, 8 of 12), d2-apply (uploaded, attached, read back, 12 of 12, no debt), d3-verify and d4-apply-again (12 of 12, nothing written); the delivery API listed the PDF under the category on the product and the file answered 200. A new category in the input was BLOCKED in apply: save_product_asset_categories is not offered by 0.6.3.

The whole-build recipe set on a fresh fictional input after the add-in was rolled 0.6.3-BETA -> 0.6.6-BETA: 1-verify (two categories, two PDF files and two documents WOULD-CREATE, after pim.identifiers in the order), 2-apply (categories created by save_product_asset_categories with the pdf filter, two generated PDF datasheets uploaded and attached in their categories, 9 of 9, no debt), 3-verify, 4-apply-again and 5-verify (9 of 9, nothing written); GET /dwapi/ecommerce/products/{id} listed each PDF under its category systemName and each file answered 200. MCP-only on a second fresh input: every step CREATED over MCP, 8 of 9 with the delivery probe not observable.

traps: Up to MCP 0.6.3 no MCP tool creates a product asset category; 0.6.6 adds save_product_asset_categories (and delete_product_asset_categories).

A document is a file detail like an image: add_product_image with the category's groupId files it under that category, and the delivery API product read lists it in assetCategories by the category's systemName.
